law.text:
A motorboat shall not be required to be numbered under this chapter if it is:
A motorboat which has been awarded a number pursuant to federal law or a federally approved numbering system of another state if the boat has been within the Commonwealth for less than ninety consecutive days.
A motorboat from a country other than the United States temporarily using the waters of the Commonwealth.
A motorboat which is used in a governmental function by the United States, a state or a subdivision of the state.
A ship's lifeboat.
A vessel which has a valid marine document issued by the Bureau of Customs of the United States government or any federal agency successor thereto.
A racing boat used during an authorized race and during a twenty-four-hour period before and after the race.
A motorboat belonging to a class of vessels which has been exempted from numbering by a regulation adopted by the Board after the Board has found that applicable federal law or federal regulation has exempted, or permitted the exemption of, such class of vessels.
A motorboat for which (i) a valid temporary registration certificate has been issued by the Department or an authorized agent of the Department, and (ii) an application has been made for a permanent registration and title (if applicable).
